blocks.text: Foz do Iguaçu – Rio de Janeiro

After breakfast, transfer to the airport for your flight to Rio de Janeiro.

On arrival, you will be met and head straight to Sugar Loaf. On the way to Praia Vermelha, enjoy views of green mountains, palm trees and the ocean.

The ascent has two stages. First, the cable car takes you to Urca Hill, with its viewing platforms, cafés and bars. You then continue up to Sugar Loaf.

From the summit, you can see Copacabana and Ipanema, Guanabara Bay, the Niterói Bridge and Corcovado with the statue of Christ the Redeemer.

After the descent, the tour continues through the city. Time permitting, you may visit the Metropolitan Cathedral of Saint Sebastian and stop at the Selarón Steps.

Return to the hotel.
